title: Charleston's Pleasing Terrors Night-Time Walking Ghost Tour

Complimentary Bottled Water included during summer months
90-Minute Pleasing Terrors Night-Time Walking Ghost Tour of Charleston
Hear suspenseful storytelling with knowledge of the hidden stories lurking in Charleston's past

requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Mike Brown is Charleston's most experienced ghost tour guide.

Mike has been giving ghost tours in Charleston for 30 years and is the host of the popular Pleasing Terrors Podcast. He has been featured on television and radio shows including the BBC, HGTV, Voice of America Radio and Destination America's Ghost Asylum.

Mike combines suspenseful storytelling with an unparalleled knowledge of the hidden and often frightening stories lurking in Charleston's past and present.

This tour offers photos, stories and authentic research not available on scripted ghost tours.

Every tour is given by Mike so you are guaranteed that the quality of the experience will match the reviews.
